rows.definition: Bounded canonical Vulkan FFN normalization operation that atomically borrows already-free exact-size native buffers and existing staging capacity, sharing scalar-required gain preparation and refusing before side effects when capacity is unavailable.
rows.distinction: An exclusive temporary allocator-buffer execution loan with selected-failure no-replay semantics; distinct from Pool (session), which owns bounded LRU session state. This operation creates neither a new persistent pool nor a device-memory budget grant.
